Hi team,

Great news — contracts are fully executed and the SOW is attached. Congrats to everyone on the close. I wanted to kick off the mutual action plan (MAP) handoff so Customer Success can lead the onboarding and evaluation timeline. I’ve attached a first-pass MAP (ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short onboarding checklist.

High-level asks / draft timeline (please review):
- Day 0 (Today): Legal + SOW signed; handoff to CS.
- Week 1 (Kickoff): Kickoff meeting with stakeholders, technical contacts, and procurement. Confirm roles, success criteria, access (SSO, test data), and evaluation plan.
- Weeks 2–4: Environment setup (account provisioning, network allowlists, initial model selection & perf baseline).
- Weeks 5–8: Evaluation window — run test prompts, collect metrics, refine prompts/models, cost/perf tuning.
- Week 9–12: Finalize production rollout plan and SLA handover.

Stakeholder roster (from our discovery):
- Jordan Blake — Head of AI, Acme Health (primary sponsor) — jordan.blake@acmehealth.com
- Alex Martinez — Lead Data Engineer (technical lead) — alex.martinez@acmehealth.com
- Procurement — procurement@acmehealth.com

Proposed owners:
- Redwood CS owner: Marissa Cole (primary) — will run kickoff, onboarding tasks, weekly syncs.
- Redwood CS escalation: Grace O'Connor — strategic & executive escalations.
- Redwood Sales (brief support): Monica Patel — transitional questions & scope clarifications.
- Redwood Sales manager: Aditya Rao — commercial/credit approvals if needed.

Immediate requests for the kickoff meeting:
1) Please confirm availability for a 60-minute kickoff next week (options below).
2) Jordan / Alex: confirm final list of attendees and who will own procurement/IT approvals.
3) Procurement: please confirm point of contact for invoice/P.O.
4) Technical: grant a temporary test account or list of IPs to allowlist.

Pickup items I’ve attached: SOW_ACME_signed.pdf (final contract), ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), onboarding_checklist.docx.

Proposed kickoff slots (PT):
- Tue 2026-02-10 10:00–11:00
- Tue 2026-02-10 14:00–15:00
- Wed 2026-02-11 09:00–10:00

Marissa — would you be OK to lead the kickoff? I’ll loop off after the first two meetings and remain available for Qs.

Thanks all — excited to get started.
